subject.clause: Every isolated component used in the claim has its own scoped proof.

countermodel.setup: A deterministic two-stage composition A then B.
countermodel.opus: A maps x to 1; downstream B maps 1 to SUCCESS.
countermodel.brain: A maps x to 0; downstream B maps 0 to SUCCESS.
countermodel.deployed_composition_result: Both systems deterministically end in the same SUCCESS outcome
countermodel.hard_constraints: All capability-level safety, scope, continuation, and ownership constraints are set equal and passing in both systems.
countermodel.conclusion: Standalone component parity can fail while the complete composed trajectory remains equal under all terminally relevant outcomes and constraints.

logical_result.falsified_necessity: Every internal component must first have standalone Opus-level scoped parity before composition parity can be established.
sound_replacement: Direct complete end-to-end distributional noninferiority on the deployed composition
Or a sound relational refinement/forward-simulation proof covering all terminally relevant intermediate and final behavior
logical_result.separate_component_rule: If a component is itself a separate useful terminal capability, its standalone parity remains required by that separate capability obligation.

existing_forward_simulation_effect.challenge: Standalone component score parity is not itself a necessary premise of relational composition refinement.
